items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When you were on the road like that, did you ever meet Benny Goodman or Tommy Dorsey or Don Stratton? [INTERVIEWEE] No, we met Bob Cosby...

ctx.x: Jay Golson didn't have anybody in the family. Wasn't he related to Benny the Tenno player?
How do you spell his name?
